name: Sri Shantambika Temple, Kigga
summary: Kigga — Western Ghats shrine of Shantambika with Rishyasringa, tied to Sringeri’s sacred geography.
famousFor: Shanta as Shantambika near Sringeri · Rishyasringa kshetra
mythology: Sringeri’s landscape remembers Rishyasringa; at Kigga, Shanta is worshipped as Sri Shantambika beside him. The peetham’s later consecration of Shantambika renewed a quieter Ramayana thread — the sister whose marriage and yajna made Rama’s birth possible in the epic’s wider memory.
